Tara_CS: Aurelia Health is doing a regional failover test next week and asked for SG ingress SNI allowlist + a short ramped QPS increase for RTO testing. They also raised renewal pricing questions last touch.
Carlos (Aurelia Health): Correct. Test window: 2026-03-26 02:00-05:00 SGT. We will fail traffic from us-east to sg to validate latency/RTO. Our proxy uses SNI 'aurelia-prod.traffic'. We need SNI allowlist + a gradual QPS ramp to 200 over 30m then steady for 2h, then ramp down. Can you set logs to 21 days? Compliance requires 3 weeks.
Evan_SE: We can do SNI-based rules on apac-edge. Recommend soft limits: start 50 qps -> 200 qps over 30m -> hold 2h -> scale down. We'll auto-revoke ramps after window. I'll prepare a perf runbook and cost delta for renewal.
Mina_Networks: I'll author the ingress rule and a temporary capacity reservation on apac-dedicated to avoid throttling. Staging manifest: ```
ingress_rule:
  tenant: AUR-211
  sni: "aurelia-prod.traffic"
  allow: true
trafffic_plan:
  ramp_sequence: [50,100,150,200]
  step_duration: 600s
  hold_duration: 7200s
auto_revoke: 2026-03-26T05:15:00+08:00
logging:
  retention_days: 21
notes: "regional failover test; renew-discussion follow-up"
```
config-bot: Change staged by Mina_Networks on apac-edge-2. Staging ID: stg-c4d9. Reservation: dedicated-req-aur-211. Scheduled apply: 2026-03-26T01:45:00+08:00.
Mina_Networks: Applied patch stg-c4d9 -> live. SNI allowlist in place; dedicated reservation confirmed for test window. Alerts set: 5xx > 0.25% OR p95 token-latency > 350ms.
Carlos (Aurelia Health): We see initial connections succeeded and TLS SNI matches. Traffic ramping as planned. Quick question: will cost snapshot include the dedicated reservation delta?
Tara_CS: Yes — Evan will include both token cost and reservation amortized delta in the renewal packet. Also capturing this as a renewal-risk tick; we should propose a pilot discount or committed-month offer if test shows stable perf.
Evan_SE: I'll run the snapshot 1h into the hold window and post numbers here: tokens, p95 latency, error rate, and estimated incremental cost for the 3h window. Also will add recommendations: caching TTLs, batching options, and potential quantization to reduce GPU footprint.
Carlos (Aurelia Health): Appreciate it. Also please confirm logs redact PHI payloads; we only want headers and metadata stored.
Mina_Networks: Confirmed: payload redaction enabled, headers+status+latency retained. 21d retention tag applied.
Tara_CS: OK closing loop: action items assigned (Evan: perf+cost snapshot; Mina: ensure auto-revoke and alerts; Tara: follow-up renewal proposal). I'll update CRM AUR-211 and set renewal follow-up for 3 days post-test. If issues appear, page oncall. Thanks team!
